activate_strength.description: Automates the overworld activation of the STRENGTH move from the party menu by navigating to the second party member (ROCKY/GEODUDE), selecting STRENGTH, and completely closing all menus back to the overworld. Uses robust cursor positioning to handle any persistent menu state.
